summary: SAM3 masking foundation carded from the masking brainstorm - refiner swap + points rewrite, split out of MPI-379.

Implementation started. Scope cut by the user to the POINTS PATH only. Blocker found in orientation: SAM3 cannot replace the SAM 1 refiner by rewiring - SAM 1 sits in ImpactSimpleDetectorSEGS.sam_model_opt (node 1588) which wants an Impact SAM_MODEL, while SAM3 box prompts want BOUNDING_BOX dicts that nothing in the graph emits from YOLO SEGS. That bridge needs a new MpiNodes node plus an mpi-ci release plus a node_lock bump. SAM 1 is KEPT for segment refine; both weights ship as engineAsset (user chose keep-both). Refiner swap moves to MPI-379. Compact plan attached.
Checklist derived from the compact plan - 6 steps, points path only.

Automated half PASSED. Weight uploaded to R2 and verified (rclone lsl plus HTTP HEAD both report 1745546848 bytes, sha256 9ba99c92); sam3-multiplex declared engineAsset. Workflow reconverted with an explicit path, 0 dangling. Grep sweep for the retired points plumbing returns nothing; eslint and node --check clean. Suite 232 pass / 9 fail with the failure LIST unchanged. New guard tests/auto-mask-inject-titles.test.cjs 3/3, negative-controlled in FIVE directions. DEFECT CAUGHT PRE-SHIP: the first cut used MpiString for the coord nodes, but MpiString is in comfyController PATH_MEDIA_CLASSES, so the JSON coords would have gone through _resolveMediaPath and _uploadRemoteMedia and broken the REMOTE leg while local passed. Fixed by using MpiText, which is the repo existing convention for plain text versus a media path. Open question from the plan answered with no code: an existing install DOES pick up a new engineAsset via checkUniversalWorkflowDepsStatus into repair-deps, precedent recorded on the rife47 entry. Awaiting the user local and Pod checks.

Local run USER-VERIFIED. Card set to doing/validating; Pod leg deferred by the user. Pod research done: no image rebuild needed (dev image already ComfyUI 0.28, digest-verified in MPI-341), weight rides R2, stable tag is a separate promote decision, and the one unverified item is whether the remote install path picks up a newly added engineAsset. Mac/Linux clear - no onnxruntime anywhere in the SAM3 stack.
Pod-only checks moved to the MPI-385 RunPod verification umbrella - they clear in one Pod session instead of one per card. Evidence still lands here.
